cohort: 111 pregnant women with a singleton pregnancy and a history of at least 1 previous cesarean delivery, diagnosed with an anterior low-lying placenta or placenta previa, delivered electively after 32 weeks of gestation
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound examination is valuable in predicting surgical outcomes in patients with a history of previous cesarean delivery, with specific findings like thin distal lower uterine segment and high lacuna score being associated with increased hysterectomy risk.
